schema.description: The writable fields of a Concept Store. Every field is replaced on update; omitted optional fields are cleared.

name.description: The display name of the Concept Store, unique across the Merchant. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed.

externalId1.description: Your own identifier for the Concept Store, unique across the Merchant. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed; a blank value is stored as null.

externalId2.description: A second identifier of your own for the Concept Store, unique across the Merchant. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed; a blank value is stored as null.

schema.title: Stores.ConceptStoreRequest
